notes: Rider pose taxonomy for rideable Pokemon (Phase 3, item B), decided 2026-11-22, refined 2026-11-22 14:59 CST into THREE pose sets: riley (custom, expressive) and tasha (custom, composed) with one signature extra state each, and generic (neutral) shared by the four Custom presets. QA INTEGRATION 2026-11-22: Neon's ride sheets (v1 + v2) were visually graded (qa/qa_ride_riley.md, qa/qa_ride_tasha.md, qa/qa_ride_generic_a.md, qa/qa_ride_generic_b.md) and ONLY the accepted primary figures were sliced into systems/cast/rider_frame_data.json. Bound today: riley 13 poses complete + mount_wave partial (wave frame only, idle missing); tasha 12 poses complete + hover_descend partial (1 of 2 frames), fly_carried still art_pending (rejected in both versions); each Custom preset 11-12 of 13 poses bound -- the generic set's per-cast truth lives in art_status_by_cast / frames_bound_by_cast because the four presets do not share one status (climb_cling is bound only for custom_femboy; climb_stand is missing for custom_femboy and custom_futanari). Rejected figures were never sliced and nothing was substituted. QA ROUND 4 (2026-11-22): layered ride delivery graded (hidden_files/qa_round4/verdicts/rides_custom.md, rides_riley_tasha.md) and the accepted stacks sliced by tools/slice_qa_art_round4.py into rider_frame_data.json's "layered" section. For the four Custom presets the layered trainer_canon stacks supersede the round-1 flat bindings pose by pose (poses not bound in layered canon keep their flat entries: custom_femboy fly_carried and climb_cling). Two climb_cling gaps closed this round: custom_female and custom_futanari are now bound (1 frame each, layered canon); custom_male climb_cling stays art_pending (its only cling figure holds a drawn rock). Riley and Tasha layered outfits are alternates bound in the layered section (Riley lounge 14 frames incl. the dive_hold pass-with-fault slab, Riley bikini 11, Tasha gothic_glam 11); their canon ride look stays on the round-1 flat bindings -- no canon ride layers were delivered. Named gaps still open: tasha fly_carried, tasha hover_descend (still 1 of 2), riley mount_wave idle frame, custom_male climb_cling, custom_femboy + custom_futanari climb_stand (and climb_stand for custom_female / custom_male, still unbound in layered canon). Tasha's gothic_glam gallop calm (R1F2) and surf_kneel (R1F5) figures are accepted but unsliceable inside un-keyable purple patches on her off-spec magenta sheets. QA ROUND 5 (2026-11-23): ride singles graded (hidden_files/qa_round5/verdicts/rides_tandem.md) and sliced by tools/slice_qa_art_round5.py. Closed this round: riley mount_wave (idle frame bound, 2/2 complete), tasha fly_carried (bound -- her custom set is now fully bound), tasha hover_descend (frame 2 bound, 2/2, feet-anchored against the 224 vs 251 px height fault), generic climb_cling for custom_male (pose now bound for all four Custom presets), and generic climb_stand for custom_femboy and custom_futanari. Generic climb_stand is now bound for all four Custom presets (custom_female and custom_male were already bound in round 1), so the generic set's climb pair is fully closed. Riley/Tasha climb_stand were already bound in round 1 and are unaffected. Passing climb_cling singles for custom_female and custom_futanari are spares in rider_frame_data.json, not bindings. QA ROUND 6 (2026-11-23): rides graded (hidden_files/qa_round6/verdicts_rides.md) and sliced by tools/slice_qa_art_round6.py. Riley and Tasha canon ride bindings are now the layered canon stacks (Riley 12 poses / 14 frames, Tasha 11 poses / 13 frames), superseding the round-1 flat frames pose by pose. Singles bound: riley ride_land_gallop calm (her gallop pair is complete), riley climb_stand, tasha climb_stand, tasha hover_stand wind (her hover_stand pair is complete). climb_stand is now bound for ALL SIX cast members (the four Custom presets closed in rounds 1/5; Riley and Tasha are covered by the round-6 singles rather than layered stacks -- see their art_notes). custom_male climb_cling was replaced by the round-6 v2 single (true back-view cling); the round-5 frame is a spare in rider_frame_data.json. Tasha gothic_glam layered set reached 13 stacks after the rekey freed gallop calm and surf_kneel; Tasha obsidian_bikini v2 bound 9 poses / 11 frames and Custom Femboy swimwear v2 bound 10 poses / 12 frames in the layered section (alternate outfits; the generic set's statuses here are unchanged).

riley.personality: expressive, confident, playful; she is enjoying every second

poses.description: seated tall, chin up, confident grin.
leaning forward laughing, one fist pumped.
poses.art_note: COMPLETE (QA round 6): the wind frame is the new layered canon stack; the calm slot -- which had no layered base figure -- is covered by the round-6 single (front three-quarter gallop crouch, one fist pumped; the same pose as her round-1 flat calm, redrawn in the canon outfit). Covered by a single rather than a layered stack, recorded here.

tasha.personality: composed, cool, unbothered; the hover_stand is her signature

poses.description: upright and composed, cool gaze.
low and serious, hair streaming, Klefki charm flying behind her.
one foot forward, arms loose, balance effortless.
kneeling gracefully, brushing her hair back.
legs stretched out, leaning back on her hands, at ease.
gripping calmly, looking out over the view, slight smile.
arms crossed even while dangling. Unimpressed.
poses.art_note: BOUND (QA round 5): redrawn as specified -- dangling mid-air, arms crossed, unimpressed, nothing drawn to hang from. The twice-rejected pose is closed.

poses.description: perfectly streamlined, elegant, almost balletic.
clinging with a sigh, one eyebrow up.
standing with arms folded, surveying like a queen.
poses.art_note: BOUND via the round-6 single (QA round 6): standing tall like a queen, arms folded, chin up, no drawn props. The layered sheets only ever had back-view climb steps for her; the single is the binding, recorded here.

poses.description: THE pose: arms folded, chin high, hair moving in the hover wind. This is her Metagross moment; make it the best frame on the sheet.
poses.art_note: PAIR COMPLETE (QA round 6): calm is the new layered canon stack frame; wind is the round-6 single (arms folded, chin high, hair streaming sideways -- a true wind partner to the calm frame). The wind frame is a single rather than a layered stack, recorded here.

poses.description: seated sideways like she ordered this service, legs crossed.
crouched, brushing dust off her sweater, annoyed but enduring.
standing tall, arms still folded, while the hovering Pokemon lowers her to the ground. The arrival shot.
poses.art_note: COMPLETE 2/2 (QA round 5) with the verdict's fault recorded: frame 2's figure is 224 px tall vs frame 1's 251 px. Both frames are feet-anchored on the shared 285x266 canvas in rider_frame_data.json, so she does not drop between frames; the difference reads as the touchdown crouch.
